Ines Okafor was transported to the island by Tobiah Wren, the ferryman. Ines Okafor was tasked with becoming the new keeper of the Salt Ledger.

Tobiah Wren informed Ines Okafor that Aldous Brandt had been gone for three weeks. Tobiah Wren gave Ines Okafor a small brass key that Aldous Brandt had given him. Tobiah Wren warned Ines Okafor to keep the brass key off the ledger and away from the council.

Ines Okafor noticed the spring pages were missing from the Salt Ledger. What does Mara Venn know about the missing pages from the Salt Ledger?

Tobiah Wren informed Ines Okafor that Aldous Brandt had been gone for three weeks. Tobiah Wren gave Ines Okafor a small brass key that Aldous Brandt had given him. Mara Lisle stated that Aldous Brandt stopped sleeping in his last month. Ines Okafor counted the salt over four days, noting discrepancies. Ines Okafor found a printed handbill pasted over the November page.

Ines Okafor dropped the handbill in the stove and continued her work. Ines Okafor peeled the handbill away with a knife. What does the small brass key that Tobiah Wren gave Ines Okafor unlock?

rows.text:
Ines Okafor was the passenger on the ferry arriving at Harrow Quay. Mara Venn was the Harbourmaster who met Ines Okafor at the location. Ines Okafor sought to find anyone who had previously worked with Aldous Brandt.

Tobiah Wren, the ferryman, told Ines Okafor that Aldous Brandt had been absent for three weeks. Mara Venn guided Ines Okafor to the archive where the Salt Ledger was kept. Ines Okafor noticed that the spring pages were missing from the Salt Ledger. Mara Lisle, who worked in the net loft, told Ines Okafor that Aldous Brandt stopped sleeping. Ines Okafor found a printed handbill pasted over the November page of the ledger. Ines Okafor copied her salt count, noting forty barrels in the book and sixty-four on receipts. Dr Pike found Ines Okafor on the tower steps at first light.

Dr Pike offered Ines Okafor his strongbox in the dispensary for her receipts. This kind offer from Dr Pike seemed sensible to Ines Okafor. What does Dr Pike know about the Salt Ledger that he offers to Ines Okafor?

rows.text:
Ines Okafor was the passenger on the ferry arriving at Harrow Quay. Mara Venn was the Harbourmaster who met Ines Okafor at the location. Tobiah Wren was the ferryman who transported Ines Okafor to the island. Dr Pike owned the dispensary that contained the island's only press. Ines Okafor was trying to find anyone who had worked with Aldous Brandt. Ines Okafor was trying to count the salt to verify the ledger's records.

Tobiah Wren informed Ines Okafor that Aldous Brandt had been gone for three weeks. Mara Venn led Ines Okafor to the archive where the Salt Ledger was kept. Ines Okafor discovered that the spring pages were torn out of the Salt Ledger. Mara Lisle stated that Aldous Brandt stopped sleeping in his last month. Ines Okafor copied her salt count onto a single sheet, noting forty barrels in the book and sixty-four on the receipts. The archive lamp went out while Ines Okafor was in the room. Dr Pike found Ines Okafor on the tower steps at first light. Dr Pike offered Ines Okafor his strongbox in the dispensary for her receipts. Ines Okafor heard the street door open and someone climbing the stairs late at night. Ines Okafor asked Mara Venn to open the salt warehouse for counting the barrels. Ines Okafor discovered a printed handbill pasted over the November page of the ledger. Mara Venn stated that she knew nothing about the missing pages. Mara Lisle mentioned that Aldous Brandt was counting barrels at night. Ines Okafor dismissed the printed handbill as a prank from the dock boys.

Dr Pike made Ines Okafor sit and listened to the whole story with his hands folded. Dr Pike suggested Ines Okafor give him the receipts tonight. It was a kind offer and a sensible one from Dr Pike. What does Anselm Pike know about the Salt Ledger that he offers to Ines Okafor?
